description: Convert a JSON array of objects into a Markdown table. Automatically detects columns, aligns headers, and fills missing keys with empty cells. Use when an agent needs to present structured data — tool results, model comparisons, test reports — as a readable table in a response or document.

columns.description: Column names and order (default: all keys from first row)

input.description: The array of objects to render — a JSON string, or the array itself.

name: format_table
